test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 6 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: B, C, D, E, F, G, H and I are eight nurses sitting in a straight row, facing north. G sits to the immediate right of D. Only B sits to the left of H. D sits second to the right of C. G sits second to the left of I. E and G are immediate neighbours. C and F are immediate neighbours. Who sits at the fourth position from the left end?
solution:
Given: B, C, D, E, F, G, H and I are eight nurses sitting in a straight row, facing north.

1) Only B sits to the left of H.

2) G sits to the immediate right of D.

3) G sits second to the left of I.

4) E and G are immediate neighbours.

5) D sits second to the right of C.

6) C and F are immediate neighbours.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3d8c731963f820e9ceb5f1b733fe19bfaf0c6a17b777da4c869f775af63806f4.png] 

So, 'F' sits at the fourth position from the left end.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3"**.
